items.proposed: Keep A's row: BRAF, eligibility, candidate_matched false
items.reason: Exclusion criterion 'Patients with BRAFV600E mutations are excluded' makes BRAF V600E-negative status a condition of entry; it is not linked to the ATM inhibitor AZD1390, so candidate_matched false. The manual does not say explicitly whether an exclusion-only biomarker counts as eligibility; B read it as a diagnostic exclusion.

Follows from the BRAF eligibility row above ('Patients with BRAFV600E mutations are excluded'); any eligibility biomarker other than IDH-wildtype used to define GBM counts. If XL decides exclusion-only biomarkers are not selection, this becomes false.
Same partner, wording only ('[RADIATION] Radiation Therapy (other names: ... Radiotherapy, RT ...)'); the manual's term 'radiotherapy' is proposed.

note: Primary outcome is unaffected (BRAF row is not candidate-matched). Cross-trial consistency point for XL: biomarker requirements stated only as exclusions (here BRAF V600E; also RB1 loss in NCT05843253) are proposed as eligibility rows. Paediatric/young adult trial (mixed_age); glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype named in inclusion, so cns5.
